tolerance_rationale: LiH rocksalt / STO-3G / LDA / Γ-only. Light-element ionic — STO-3G handles Li/H reasonably (vs deeper-core Na/Mg/Cl). 10 mHa tolerance leaves room for XC-grid + FFT-Poisson differences without flagging the v0.6.x absolute-energy quirks (this is the system used in tests/test_periodic_atomic_limit_bug.py xfail).
published_source: Peintinger 2013 J. Comput. Chem. 34, 451 SI Table 1 — pob-TZVP / PW1PW / multi-k. Advisory only at this (basis, method, kmesh): the published reference is at pob-TZVP basis with PW1PW (Bredow's 1-parameter hybrid, 20% HF + 80% PW91 exchange + PW91 correlation) and full Brillouin-zone integration; vibe-qc here runs sto-3g / RKS-LDA / Γ-only. Strict numerical match needs PW1PW + multi-k + pob-TZVP, all queued for v0.8+ per docs/roadmap.md.
published_source_hf: Peintinger 2013 SI Table 2 — pob-TZVP / HF / multi-k. Same level-of-theory caveats as PW1PW above.
